binarize_text_to_ids: binarize a text file into token IDs using a dictionary and consumer callback
binarize_alignments: binarize an alignment file by parsing each line with an alignment parser and consumer
find_offsets_for_chunks: find byte offsets in a file to split it into a given number of chunks
safe_readline_unicode: read a line from a file safely recovering from Unicode decode errors
binarize_already_numberized: binarize an already numberized text file by parsing integer IDs and appending EOS
